name: spoken_refusal
about: The step's first reply reads the note back, asks, and saves in the same reply. The save is refused because the caller has said nothing in the step yet. That reply already spoke, so no second reply follows: the caller answers next, and the save goes through.
instructions: You help callers with their orders.

tasks.name: take_note
tasks.when: The caller wants to leave a note.

turns.caller: Please note that I want a call back.

model.text: Your note: a call back. Is that right?

spoken: Your note: a call back. Is that right?
